description: ACM's acmart in its single-column manuscript format, as Flouest's acm template loads it: without General's font and AMS lines, since the template writes only mathtools after the class line, and with an empty \title, which the template writes for a document without one. Under XeTeX acmart sets its maths with unicode-math (acmart.dtx l.4058-4065), and General's lmodern, loaded after it, took the maths fonts back to 8-bit Latin Modern, so every maths letter and symbol printed nothing (batch 3b: 3,008 missing glyphs in 193 of 512 documents, each failing its whole document). acmart's page heads print \shorttitle on odd pages (acmart.dtx l.8076, l.8118, l.8142), which only amsart's \title defines, so a document with no title stopped at 'Undefined control sequence \shorttitle' on every odd page from the third (batch 3b: 216 of 512 documents, document-wide in 111). A title way's own \title replaces the empty one. Since b23 (ERRORS ACM-REFLINE) the setting turns off acmart's ACM Reference Format block (\settopmatter{printacmref=false}, acmart.cls l.1787-1792), which \maketitle prints after the title block (l.2329-2331) with \@title inline after the authors and the year (\@mkbibcitation, l.2891-2925): General's title is a box as wide as the line (title.ts), so after '. 2023. ' it ran 21.6pt past the measure in every document holding it (GitHub run r2-461ed0e: 0 of 13 General title branches passed in each acmart pair, e.g. d7bf5d19e2529793c571c, 'Overfull \hbox (21.60265pt too wide) ... . 2023. []'), and a title holding a footnote met the block's own \footnote, which stops at 'Please do not use footnotes inside a \title{} or \author{} command!' (l.2897-2899; 3 documents in each pair). acmart only warns at the end that the format is mandatory for papers over one page (l.1793-1800). A test-setting choice: Flouest's acm template writes \setcopyright{none} for a manuscript and keeps the block (O-AC8's \setcopyright{none}, left out in b22, does not touch it). With the block gone a title footnote no longer stops TeX, but acmart's title block still prints it nowhere (GitHub probe 41775212344, ERRORS-acm-fntitle-new: the note's sentinels never ship).
